F1.description: Direct imports from another module's repository, bypassing the service boundary and event bus

F2.description: Raw Error throws in service methods, bypassing the typed AppError hierarchy

F3.description: Tests that assert HTTP status codes without verifying business rule compliance

F4.description: Missing event bus integration — state changes written directly to sibling module repositories

checks.description: module boundaries and service-contract integrity (failure mode F1)
typed AppError hierarchy and error-response ownership (failure mode F2)
business-rule assertions rather than status-code-only tests (failure mode F3)
event-driven cross-module state changes (failure mode F4)
